construction.implementation_origin: Original implementation written for this isolated build

shared_schema.description: One JSON envelope preserves core input entities in output. validate() validates the common fields before and after the onboarding transformation. Unknown envelope fields are preserved, while computed output fields are always regenerated.

required_fields.profile: experience: novice/intermediate/expert; preference: concise/detailed; completed_steps: unique prerequisite-closed list
required_fields.work_order: ERP/MES-style object: work_order_id, asset_id, product_id, positive integer quantity, status: planned/in_progress/hold/completed, timezone-aware created_at
required_fields.telemetry_csv: Nonempty embedded time-series CSV; exact columns: reading_id,timestamp,asset_id,metric,value,unit,tolerance_min,tolerance_max
required_fields.quality_inspections: List, possibly empty: inspection_id, work_order_id, asset_id, inspector, timestamp, characteristic=shaft_diameter, value, unit=mm, tolerance={min,max}, decision=pass/fail, rationale, evidence_reading_id
required_fields.maintenance_logs: List, possibly empty: log_id, asset_id, synthetic=true, timestamp, technician, action

output_extensions.status: ok for valid requests, including those with operational blockers
output_extensions.telemetry_readings: Normalized typed sensor records with within_tolerance and safety_critical flags
output_extensions.quality_decisions: Traceable quality decisions including source IDs, inspector, rationale, timestamp, measurement, tolerance and versioned rule
output_extensions.onboarding: Ordered steps with prerequisites, state, explanation and experience-specific guidance; blockers, next_step, complete, release_readiness and operational_authorization=false

cross_stage_handoffs: One functionality only: shared validation produces normalized telemetry for adaptive onboarding; onboarding preserves the original work order, inspection and maintenance entities and returns guidance and decision traces.

behavior.prerequisites: Each step requires every earlier step. Reported completed steps must be prerequisite-closed. Completion is client-supplied training state, not authenticated certification.
behavior.adaptation: Novices receive worked examples, intermediates guided checklists, experts verification checklists. Explicit concise/detailed preference independently controls explanation length. Experience never bypasses prerequisites.
behavior.units_and_tolerances: Strict C and mm/s sensor units; temperature physical range [-20,150], vibration [0,50]; shaft diameter in mm with value (0,1000]. Finite numbers and inclusive ordered tolerance bounds are required.
behavior.safety: Temperature >=85 C or vibration >=12 mm/s always emits a pending human escalation, regardless of configurable tolerance. Alerts prevent release readiness, even when all steps were reported complete.
behavior.quality: Decisions must agree with inclusive dimensional limits. Inspector, time, rationale, work order, matching asset and existing evidence reading are mandatory. Evidence cannot postdate inspection. This demonstrates ISO 9001-related traceability principles without claiming compliance or certification.
behavior.release_blockers: Safety alerts, out-of-tolerance telemetry, missing inspection, failed inspection, or work order on hold. No real machine authorization occurs.
behavior.synthetic_fixtures: All IDs and people are fictitious; maintenance logs are invented and labeled synthetic. synthetic_fixture(seed=67) produces reproducible physically plausible randomized temperature and vibration samples.
behavior.determinism: No clock reads, external state, network calls or providers in application logic. Same input yields same output. Seeded fixture generation is reproducible.
behavior.cli: Exactly one JSON object to stdout. Exit 0 for valid requests, exit 2 for validation, JSON, encoding, usage or file errors. No traceback for expected input errors.

included: One common envelope and validation layer
Strict entity relationships and chronological telemetry
Human escalation records and transparent quality traces
Standard-library unittest and subprocess CLI tests
excluded: Production deployment, certification or legal compliance guarantees
Real machine control, automatic release, or automatic safety clearance
Live ERP/MES integrations, external CSV files and network notification delivery
Persistent audit storage, authentication and signed training completion
LLMs, live model providers, and external dependencies

coverage: Normal onboarding and shared input/output validation
Seeded randomized fixtures and deterministic results
Experience, explanation preference and prerequisite progression
Safety thresholds independent of configurable tolerances
Units, finite values, physical bounds and inclusive tolerances
Traceability, entity links and chronological evidence
Failed or missing inspections and blocked release
CSV, malformed schema and synthetic maintenance validation
CLI success, missing file, usage, malformed JSON and duplicate keys
